question: Do both declarative ERBB configuration/source-manifest files exactly match the original pre-outcome numerical freeze and its recorded input hashes?
decision: Resolve changed-asset registration for two already frozen declarative dependencies without modifying the original contract, scripts, inputs, results or validators.
strongest_rival: Post-outcome configuration changes could be mistaken for prospectively frozen choices if provenance is not verified against the numerical commit.
discriminator: Compare both current file bytes to their exact blobs in the numerical receipt commit and to the original contract input hashes; require both to match.
exposure_record: All numerical outcomes and completed figure are exposed. This is provenance repair only; both assets were already committed and hash-locked as inputs before the original numerical run.
biological_unit: Two declarative configuration records, not biological samples.
nesting_and_overlap: These records are the original inputs to the completed A12 single-preparation screen; no new data, independent sample or biological observation is created.
population_and_selection: Exactly erbb_sorted_spec_v1.json and erbb_sorted_sources_v1.json, identified by the failed changed-asset check; no additional scientific assets.
contrast: Current bytes versus original frozen Git blobs and original contract SHA256 values, for each of the two records.
endpoint: Exact byte and SHA256 equality and original pre-outcome commit presence; no receptor expression endpoint is recalculated.
methods: Read both records as declarative dependencies, original contract and executed receipt; git show the original commit blobs; fail on any byte/hash mismatch; write a small provenance receipt output.
missingness_and_exclusions: No record substitution or rewriting; missing file, original commit, contract input declaration or mismatching hash stops execution.
multiplicity: Two fixed provenance records; no statistical testing or selective reporting.
precision_basis: Deterministic provenance equality is checked exactly; no biological precision estimate applies.
interpretation_limit: A provenance registration check does not add biological validation, recover cell labels or alter the single-preparation RNA interpretation.
stop_rule: Fail on any missing input, hash mismatch, historical-byte change or nonexecuted numerical receipt. Preserve every frozen record; never weaken the validator.
amendment_reason: Original spec and source manifest were hash-bound inputs but omitted from changed-asset dependency registration. This separate metadata contract binds and verifies those unchanged original declarative assets; no retrospective scientific choice.
